changeLog: Polished the Raid Reload interface to match the warm Clash-of-Clans webview theme with custom 3D buttons. Redesigned the screen to act as a standalone tab by removing the return arrow and merging floating overlay menu and VPN configurations into a unified 'Setup Settings' button with a modern overlay permission choice Dialog. Configured a continuous smooth breathing/pulsing animation loop for the golden floating screen-border button.
